description: A pot of brass wool that wipes old solder and burnt flux off a hot soldering iron tip.
how_to_use: Stab the hot tip in and out of the brass wool a few times between joints, then add a little fresh solder to the tip (tinning) so it stays shiny.

plain.what: A pot of metal wool for cleaning the soldering iron's tip.
plain.how: Poke the hot tip in and out a few times between joints to keep it shiny.
